summary.text: Donnie Berthiaume is a Republican state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 5th Worcester District since January 7, 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Donald Berthiaume Jr. has held the 5th Worcester District seat since January 7, 2015, according to Ballotpedia.

Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Cannabis Policy Joint Committee and the Judiciary Joint Committee, on both of which he is ranking minority member, along with the Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure and Housing joint committees.
